text.en: The salon staff earns consistent praise for friendliness, welcoming service, and attentive client communication. Reviewers frequently thank groomer Irma for skilled styling and note that the front desk team creates an inviting atmosphere. Pet parents appreciate the accommodating staff and frequently express intentions to make the salon their regular grooming destination.

Styling and bathing outcomes receive enthusiastic reviews from pet owners across various breeds. Clients commend breed-specific styling, highlighting excellent schnauzer trims alongside gentle de-matting that preserves dog coats rather than shaving them down. Reviewers note that pets leave appointments with soft, fluffy fur and neatly finished silhouettes.

Pet handling receives dedicated praise, particularly for accommodating young puppies and anxious dogs. Reviewers note that groomers successfully put nervous doodles and first-time puppies at ease, ensuring a stress-free bath and brushing routine. Clients highlight that pets return home visibly happy and relaxed after being groomed with gentle care.

q.en: Does the salon groom puppies and first-time pets?

a.en: Yes, client reviews highlight that staff members are patient and welcoming with young puppies visiting for their initial haircuts.

q.en: How does the team handle matted fur?

a.en: Reviewers note that groomers take time to carefully brush out minor mats rather than resorting to shaving the animal coat.
Yes, pet parents report good scheduling availability when booking baths and full styling services.
